The '''1966–67 [[Super League Greece|Alpha Ethniki]]''' was the 31st season of the highest [[Association football|football]] league of Greece. The season began on 23 October 1966 and ended on 18 June 1967. [[Olympiacos F.C.|Olympiacos]] won their second consecutive and 17th Greek title.

The point system was: ''Win: 3 points'' - ''Draw: 2 points'' - ''Loss: 1 point''.
